_doc: Caveman close payload — telegraphic prose, function words stripped. Carries identical load-bearing tokens to verbose-payload.json. The only difference is function-word density: this version strips articles/copulas/conjunctions while preserving every load-bearing identifier, path, line ref, PR number, SHA, name, number, and decision. Used by test-caveman-economy.js to prove caveman mode reduces bootstrap tokens without losing any load-bearing token.
